gearsSvg.title: Epicyclic Gear Train — SVG
gearsSvg.sunBody: Small electric motor, less powerful than MG2. It allows varying the transmission ratio between ICE and MG2 by spinning the central gear in one direction to act as a reducer or in the other to act as a multiplier.
gearsSvg.sunNote: It can serve as a generator during deceleration phases or when the battery needs charging. It also starts the combustion engine.
gearsSvg.carrierBody: Combustion engine. At low speed: when the battery is full it is off, when the battery is empty it propels the car alone. At high speed: it is assisted by MG2 to propel the car.
gearsSvg.carrierNote: What matters is the rotational speed of the assembly around the central gear and not the rotational speed of each gear on its own axis.
gearsSvg.ringBody: Second electric motor, more powerful than MG1. It is connected to the wheels via a chain drive and a differential.
gearsSvg.ringNote: At low speed it propels the car alone, at high speed it is assisted by ICE. During deceleration phases it can perform regenerative braking to recharge the battery.

pokemonQuiz.title: Pokémon Personality Quiz
pokemonQuiz.subtitle: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team & Blue Rescue Team
pokemonQuiz.desc: Answer 8 questions to discover which Pokémon you would be!
pokemonQuiz.question: Question
pokemonQuiz.genderQ: Last question: Are you a boy or a girl?
pokemonQuiz.followQ: You valiantly fight the aliens... But you are defeated. An alien says: "YOU HAVE IMPRESSED US. JOIN US, AND TOGETHER WE SHALL RULE THE WORLD." What will you do?
pokemonQuiz.nHardy: You're hardy and bold! You never give up, no matter what!
pokemonQuiz.nDocile: You're gentle and kind! You always think of others first.
pokemonQuiz.nBrave: You're brave and courageous! Nothing scares you!
pokemonQuiz.nJolly: You're cheerful and upbeat! You're always smiling!
pokemonQuiz.nImpish: You're mischievous and fun! You love pulling pranks!
pokemonQuiz.nNaive: You're innocent and pure! You see the best in everyone!
pokemonQuiz.nTimid: You're a bit shy... But deep down, you have a strong spirit!
pokemonQuiz.nHasty: You're quick to act! You don't waste a single moment!
pokemonQuiz.nSassy: You're sassy and confident! You always speak your mind!
pokemonQuiz.nCalm: You're calm and collected. Nothing can rattle you.
pokemonQuiz.nRelaxed: You're laid-back and carefree! You take life at your own pace.
pokemonQuiz.nLonely: You feel things deeply... You treasure the bonds you share.
pokemonQuiz.nQuirky: You're unpredictable and unique! You march to your own beat!
